turns.text: Hello. The print arrived with the wrong colours. The sky is green and it should be blue.

I’m sorry the print arrived with the wrong colours. I can file a misprint claim, but first please send the order number and the email used to place it. It must be reported within 14 days of delivery. Once verified, I’ll file the claim; staff will ask for a photo and decide on the solution.

rule.ro: Un print deteriorat sau tipărit greșit se semnalează în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul primește o retipărire sau banii înapoi. Echipa cere o fotografie și aprobă soluția.
rule.en: Report a damaged or misprinted print within 14 days of delivery. The customer gets a reprint or a refund. Staff ask for a photo and approve.

turns.text: Order SC-5219, email nymue.strambu@example.com. It was delivered recently.
I’ve filed a misprint claim for the wrong colours. It’s pending staff approval; staff will ask you for a photo and decide on the solution.

change.description: Misprint: the sky is green but should be blue.

turns.text: I have a photo for the team. I do not know whether I want a reprint or a refund, so I will let them decide after they see the photo.
That’s fine—you don’t need to choose a remedy. Your claim is pending, and staff will ask for the photo and decide after reviewing it.
